sentences.text: Halimornis was a type of bird belonging to the Enantiornithes group, an extinct lineage of early avians.
The name Halimornis translates directly to "bird of the sea".
Evidence suggests this species was ocean-going because its fossils were found about 50 km offshore.
Halimornis is classified within the family Avisauridae.
It is a monotypic genus known only from the species H. thompsoni.
Halimornis lived approximately 80 million years ago during the Late Cretaceous period.
The time range for Halimornis is estimated between 83.6 and 72.2 million years ago.
